description: This file defines the StatusChangeListener interface in the com.romraider.logger.ecu.ui package, specifying methods for handling different status events related to ECU logging and connection states.

classes.name: StatusChangeListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to status changes during ECU communication or logging processes.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Triggered when the connection to the ECU is established.

methods.name: readingData
methods.description: Triggered when data is being read from the ECU.

methods.name: loggingData
methods.description: Triggered when data logging is in progress.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Triggered when the ECU communication or logging has stopped.
